run_script:
#!/bin/bash
# final runs, one binary (bin/oracle-final), plus the baseline byte-identity check against bin/oracle-base
X=$SCRATCH
cd $X
rm -rf runs && mkdir runs
export BIN=$X/bin/oracle-final
# baseline identity (no scenario): seed 7, two chains, 40 blocks, --mutate-every 10
( cd runs && $X/bin/oracle-base gen --domain d3 --seed 7 --chains 2 --blocks 40 --mutate-every 10 --out $X/runs/bl-base > bl-base.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?" >> bl-base.log ) &
( cd runs && $X/bin/oracle-final gen --domain d3 --seed 7 --chains 2 --blocks 40 --mutate-every 10 --out $X/runs/bl-final > bl-final.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?" >> bl-final.log ) &
i=0
for c in 3 4 9 14 19; do
  s=$((101+i)); pm=0; [ $((i%2)) -eq 1 ] && pm=0.1; b=260; [ $c -eq 3 ] && b=235
  NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=4 nohup ./gen.sh yield-congestion yc$s --seed $s --first-chain $c --chains 1 --blocks $b \
    --p-missing $pm --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  i=$((i+1))
done
i=0
for c in 0 1 2 6; do
  gp=0; [ $((i%2)) -eq 0 ] && gp=100000000
  NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=3 nohup ./gen.sh curve-callbacks cc$((201+i)) --seed $((201+i)) --first-chain $c --chains 1 --blocks 95 \
    --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 --min-gas-price $gp > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=2 nohup ./gen.sh gaskey-target gk$((301+i)) --seed $((301+i)) --first-chain $c --chains 1 --blocks 52 \
    --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 --min-gas-price $gp > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=2 nohup ./gen.sh rollback-refund rb$((401+i)) --seed $((401+i)) --first-chain $c --chains 1 --blocks 50 \
    --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 --min-gas-price $gp > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=2 nohup ./gen.sh genesis-tx gx$((501+i)) --seed $((501+i)) --chains 3 --blocks 8 --p-missing 0.3 \
    --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 --min-gas-price $gp > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  i=$((i+1))
done
wait
